statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The U.S. session is trending upward with broad megacap support, but accessible NQ evidence is off the session high and semiconductor confirmation is mixed.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because repeated failed retracements are not verified; Stress stays extreme into Friday's Employment Situation.
headline: WATCH as broad tech strength meets mixed semiconductor confirmation
body: Accessible delayed NQ evidence shows an upward session, with a quote near 29,321 above the 29,207 open but below the roughly 29,376 session high. Fresh supplementary context shows 7 of 8 tracked megacaps positive, while only 3 of 7 tracked semiconductors are positive. Oil near six-week highs and Friday payroll risk keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail was mostly low overnight, rose through the U.S. macro sequence, reached WATCH at 14:00 UTC and remained WATCH at 15:00 UTC. The 2026-09-02 22:00 UTC slot remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: The immediate checkpoint is whether the current upward U.S. session keeps extending through shallow pullbacks; Tail can fall if two-way trade returns. Hammack's 19:00 UTC remarks are a medium checkpoint. Friday's 12:30 UTC Employment Situation is the next major high-Stress window.

forecast.analysis: Tail remains WATCH if the rally holds but continues to produce meaningful pullbacks. A fresh session high followed by shallow retracements and renewed extension would be the main escalation condition.

Into the later cash session, Tail can ease toward the bottom of WATCH if leadership broadens without directional efficiency increasing. A reversal back through the afternoon range would further reduce one-way risk.

Hammack's scheduled 19:00 UTC opening remarks create a medium event checkpoint. Tail stays WATCH unless the subsequent NQ response becomes persistent, holds an extreme and resists meaningful retracement.
Around the U.S. cash close, Tail falls to low if the speaker window is absorbed through two-way trade. Persistent closing extension with aligned megacap participation would be the contrary condition.
Post-close liquidity can widen individual moves, but low Tail assumes no sustained directional extension. Friday payroll proximity keeps Stress extreme even if price action becomes quieter.
During the futures maintenance transition and early evening, Tail remains low absent a new geopolitical shock or a one-way reopening gap. Thin liquidity alone is treated as Stress rather than Tail.
Early overnight trade is expected to be lower-information. Tail remains low unless futures establish a persistent direction that repeatedly survives pullbacks.
Overnight risk is dominated by headline sensitivity and payroll anticipation. Tail stays low if moves remain reversible and cross-asset signals are not uniformly aligned.

With no major scheduled U.S. release in this hour, low Tail assumes balanced overnight discovery. A sudden oil or geopolitical shock would raise Stress first unless NQ also develops persistent extension.
The Asian-session handoff remains a low-Tail window if index movement is rotational. A large move by itself is insufficient without shallow pullbacks or repeated extension.
As Europe approaches, Tail remains low while futures continue to retrace directional pushes. Cross-asset alignment matters only if NQ simultaneously shows durable one-way structure.
European participation can increase range and volatility. Tail rises only marginally because the key condition remains whether directional pushes fail to mean-revert.
With European cash trade established, payroll anticipation becomes more visible. Tail remains low if positioning is two-sided rather than a persistent pre-release drift.
U.S. premarket liquidity begins to improve. Tail remains low while pushes retrace, although Stress stays extreme as the Employment Situation approaches.
Pre-payroll repositioning can widen futures swings. Tail remains low if those swings stay reversible instead of extending repeatedly through failed pullbacks.
Event sensitivity increases with several hours left before payrolls. Tail remains low unless pre-release direction becomes unusually efficient and poorly retraced.
WATCH reflects closer payroll proximity, not an assumed release outcome. Rotational futures and conflicting cross-assets would keep Tail capped.
With roughly two and a half hours to payrolls, Stress is extreme and Tail is WATCH. Sustained pre-release extension would be the relevant escalation signal.

The final full hour before payrolls carries higher WATCH-level Tail because liquidity and positioning can become fragile. A block would still require observed persistent structure, not event importance alone.

This hour contains the scheduled 12:30 UTC Employment Situation. Tail is WATCH before the release; any higher state would depend on the observed post-release path, retracement quality and cross-asset alignment.
The first full post-payroll hour is conditional. WATCH persists while price discovery is unsettled; meaningful retracements would lower Tail, while repeated extension would raise it.
By the second post-payroll hour, Tail is forecast to ease if discovery becomes two-sided. Continued extreme-holding with failed pullbacks would invalidate that easing.
Later in the U.S. morning, Tail returns toward the lower WATCH band if the payroll impulse has been absorbed through two-way trade. Persistent continuation would keep risk elevated instead.

forecastDetail.comment: Current NQ is above the open but off the session high; broad megacap support is offset by mixed semiconductors, keeping Tail at WATCH.
Rally persistence keeps WATCH in place, but meaningful pullbacks would prevent escalation into a blocking state.
Later cash-session Tail eases if afternoon leadership broadens without increasing directional efficiency.
Hammack's 19:00 UTC remarks are an event checkpoint; higher Tail would require persistent, poorly retraced follow-through.
At the cash close, two-way absorption of the speaker window would return Tail to low.
Post-close liquidity can widen moves, but Tail stays low absent sustained extension; payroll proximity keeps Stress extreme.
